verdict.rationale: Supabase documents an AI Assistant built into the Dashboard that generates SQL queries from specifications, analyzes and suggests fixes for SQL errors, and gives context-specific feedback while you work on a table. That covers writing queries and debugging SQL errors directly. Explaining the backend as a whole is only implied by per-table recommendations, so coverage is incomplete. missing for 10: explicit documentation that the assistant explains the overall backend (schema, policies, functions), debugging beyond SQL-code errors (e.g., logs or runtime errors), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can ask an AI assistant in the dashboard to write queries, debug errors, and explain my backend

citations.quote: Supabase AI Assistant is integrated into the Supabase Dashboard to drastically improve your database management experience
If you encounter an error in your SQL code, the Assistant can quickly analyze the issue and suggest solutions
when designing a new database schema, it can generate all necessary SQL queries based on your specifications
Schema Design Assistance: Receive guidance on structuring your database and generating SQL queries.
